advisories.headline: Avoid outdoor activity in Anand Vihar
advisories.message: AQI is 432. Air quality is hazardous.
actions: Avoid all outdoor physical activity.
Wear an N95 mask if you must go outside.
Use air purifiers indoors and keep windows shut.

actions: সমস্ত বাইরের শারীরিক কার্যকলাপ এড়িয়ে চলুন।

advisories.headline: Minimise outdoor exposure — Anand Vihar
advisories.message: AQI is 432. Continuous outdoor work is unsafe.
actions: Wear an N95 mask at all times outdoors.
Rotate shifts to limit continuous exposure.
Reschedule strenuous work to lower-pollution hours.

citations.title: CPCB Health Advisory
citations.snippet: Outdoor workers, including traffic police and construction labourers, should be provided N95 masks and rotated to reduce continuous exposure when AQI is Poor or worse. Employers should reschedule strenuous outdoor work to lower-pollution hours where feasible.
